content: {"episode_id":"ep-05110","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal concerns the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05110. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55), raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia. The note further states that, given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances. We request reconsideration of the CO-197 determination on this documented basis; the authorization status is missing and this claim is 74 days from service with 106 days remaining to the filing deadline."}
